grading_note: This assignment requires a VISUAL infographic/framework plus a written reflection. Students submit an image or link plus text. Grade the visual on its described/visible content and the reflection on writing quality. Require 8-10 algorithms minimum.

excellent.description: Exceptionally clear, well-organized, immediately comprehensible. Logical arrangement with excellent visual hierarchy. Layout enhances understanding of relationships.

competent.description: Clear and organized with good visual hierarchy. Layout generally supports understanding of relationships.

needs_improvement.description: Basic organization but lacks clarity in some areas. Visual hierarchy present but inconsistent. Layout may cause some confusion.

inadequate.description: Disorganized, cluttered, or confusing. Lacks visual hierarchy. Layout obscures rather than clarifies relationships.

excellent.description: Excellent design principles with consistent color, typography, and visual elements. Highly professional, polished, visually engaging and memorable.

competent.description: Good design principles with mostly consistent color, typography, and visual elements. Professional with minor inconsistencies.

needs_improvement.description: Basic design principles with noticeable inconsistencies. Somewhat professional but needs refinement.

inadequate.description: Lacks basic design principles. Inconsistent or inappropriate color, typography, visual elements. Unprofessional appearance.

excellent.description: Flawless execution. No spelling or grammatical errors. All elements properly aligned, sized, formatted. Appropriate resolution and format.

competent.description: Good execution with minimal errors. Elements generally well-aligned, sized, and formatted. Appropriate resolution and format.

needs_improvement.description: Adequate execution with some noticeable errors. Some alignment, sizing, or formatting issues. Resolution or format may be less than ideal.

inadequate.description: Poor execution with numerous errors. Significant alignment, sizing, or formatting problems. Inappropriate resolution or format.

excellent.description: Classified with exceptional accuracy and insight. Categories perfectly appropriate, demonstrating sophisticated understanding. Classification reveals deep patterns and relationships.

competent.description: Classified accurately with appropriate categories demonstrating good understanding. Classification reveals some meaningful patterns and relationships.

needs_improvement.description: Classified with basic accuracy. Categories generally appropriate but may show limited understanding. Few meaningful patterns revealed.

inadequate.description: Classified inaccurately or inappropriately. Categories demonstrate misunderstanding of the material. Fails to reveal meaningful patterns.

excellent.description: Exceptionally represents relationships, connections, and/or differences. Visualization type perfectly suits the content and analysis goals.

competent.description: Effectively represents most relationships and connections. Visualization type generally suits the content and analysis goals.

needs_improvement.description: Represents some basic relationships but misses important connections or differences. Visualization type adequate but not ideal.

inadequate.description: Fails to represent meaningful relationships. Visualization type inappropriate for the content or analysis goals.

excellent.description: Comprehensively captures all relevant content and relationships. No important elements omitted. Level of detail perfectly appropriate.

competent.description: Captures most relevant content and relationships. Few minor elements may be omitted. Level of detail generally appropriate.

needs_improvement.description: Captures basic content but omits several relevant elements or connections. Level of detail inconsistent or sometimes inappropriate.

inadequate.description: Omits significant content or critical relationships. Level of detail insufficient or inappropriate for assignment goals.

excellent.description: Exceptional explanation of classification process with clear rationale for categories and sorting. Demonstrates sophisticated critical thinking and metacognition.

competent.description: Good explanation with adequate rationale for categories and sorting decisions. Demonstrates solid critical thinking.

needs_improvement.description: Basic explanation but limited rationale for categories or sorting. Demonstrates some critical thinking.

inadequate.description: Minimal or no explanation of process. Lacks rationale for categories. Shows little to no critical thinking.

excellent.description: Exceptional insight into personal learning process and outcomes. Thoughtfully discusses challenges, strategies, and knowledge gained. Makes meaningful connections to course concepts and broader applications.

competent.description: Good insight into learning process and outcomes. Discusses most challenges, strategies, and knowledge gained. Makes some connections to course concepts.

needs_improvement.description: Basic awareness of learning process. Mentions some challenges or knowledge gained but limited depth. Few connections to course concepts.

inadequate.description: Superficial or missing. Fails to meaningfully discuss learning process, challenges, or knowledge gained. No connections to course concepts.

excellent.description: Exceptional writing with clear, concise, well-organized prose. Flawless grammar, spelling, and mechanics. Professional tone. Properly formatted with effective headings, paragraphs, and transitions.

competent.description: Good writing with mostly clear and organized prose. Few errors. Appropriate tone and style. Generally well-formatted.

needs_improvement.description: Adequate writing with some clarity issues. Several errors. Inconsistent tone. Formatting needs improvement.

inadequate.description: Poor writing with significant clarity issues. Numerous errors. Inappropriate tone. Poor formatting.
